title: Beginner Step with a Bass Beat | Step Dance

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher uses a clear, step-by-step approach, breaking down complex movements into manageable segments. He frequently uses his assistant to demonstrate the steps, ensuring the viewer can follow along easily.

lesson_structure.note: The teacher introduces himself and his assistant.
The teacher breaks down the base beat.
The teacher demonstrates the base beat with a single stomp.
The teacher adds a left stomp and a hand clap.
The teacher explains the next stomp on the left leg.
The teacher explains how to loop the steps.
The teacher adds the actual step to the base beat.
The teacher explains the ending of the step.
The teacher and his assistant perform the full step with the base beat.

quotes.text: So we're going to start off teaching you the base beat.
So now right now, you got to understand that we just, our last stomp was on our left leg.
So now we're going to add the actual step that we need to learn to combine with this base beat.
So now we're going to take that step and mix it with the base beat to create a whole new beat.

evidence_segments.observation: The teacher stands in front of the camera and introduces himself and his assistant.
The teacher demonstrates a single stomp with his right leg, followed by a stomp with his left leg.
The teacher and his assistant perform a stomp and a clap together.
The teacher adds a left stomp and a hand clap to the sequence.
The teacher demonstrates a stomp and a clap, followed by a stomp and two claps.
